name: 服务回声
description: 把一段笔记交给一个 HTTP 服务，拿回 JSON。演示 service 执行器：POST、请求头里的环境变量、超时。 / Send a note to an HTTP service and keep the JSON it returns. Shows the service executor: POST, an env var in a header, and a timeout.

topic.description: 交给服务的题目 / Topic sent to the service

stages.name: 笔记
stages.description: 人先写一段笔记。 / A person writes a short note first.

executor.instructions: 把要发给服务的文字写进 note.md。 / Write what you want to send in note.md.

stages.name: 回声
stages.description: 把笔记 POST 给服务，服务应返回 JSON。把地址换成你自己的接口。 / POST the note to a service that returns JSON. Point the URL at your own API.
